validated.name: Turtle Soup (sweep reversal, no MSS wait)
validated.why: PF 1.893, ann. Sharpe 2.780, max DD 6.5%, profitable in 9/9 years.
validated.mechanism_label: MEAN REVERSION (post-sweep fade). The ICT filters (H4 bias + London/NY killzones) filter out winning trades — the plain sweep-fade 24/7 baseline out-performs on all headline metrics on this instrument. Deployed as-configured, but the edge is not ICT structure.
rules: 1. Sweep of a 20-bar extreme that closes back inside.
2. Entry: market on close[1] confirmation of the rejection bar.
3. Stop: beyond the sweep extreme + 0.25 x ATR.
4. Target: opposing pool; RR >= 2.0.
5. Sessions: London + NY killzones.

not_validated.name: ICT Core (sweep → displacement/MSS → FVG entry)
not_validated.why: Annualised Sharpe 0.275 below 0.5 — no risk-adjusted edge (per-trade 0.071).
rules: 1. HTF bias: H4 close[1] vs H4 EMA(50) — above = bullish, below = bearish.
2. Sweep: M15 bar takes out a confirmed swing pool and CLOSES back inside it.
3. Displacement: body >= 1.0 x ATR(14), closing in bias direction.
4. MSS: close[1] breaks the intervening swing in bias direction.
5. Entry: limit at the 50% level of the displacement-leg FVG.
6. Stop: beyond the sweep extreme + 0.25 x ATR.
7. Target: next opposing liquidity pool; reject setup if RR < 2.0.
8. Sessions: London 07:00-10:00 and NY 12:00-15:00 UTC only.
